text:
Cam (VP Product): Quick update: rolling out the Private "Signed Repair Flow" pilot for select on-prem customers. Purpose: speed up validated fixes while keeping customers in control. Pilot docs: https://intranet.redwood/signed-repair-pilot :rocket:
Diego (Eng): Tech bits: flow uses KMS-signed images + local verification. Default ask: customers provide a weekly 2hr maintenance window for planned fix application. Images are validated checksum-first; rollback image must be staged locally.
Mira (Security): Telemetry is minimal and opt-in: we collect only image hashes, signature metadata, and success/failure flags. No model or customer data leaves the environment. We'll publish signed SBOMs and attestations per image.
Olivia (CS): I'll notify pilot customers and attach a short consent form. Need a bulletized one-pager with rollback steps and expected RTO/RPO to share.
Cam (VP Product): Policy note: if we GA this flow, we'll require written consent for customers to enable automatic signed repair application. We'll give a 30-day notice before enforcement. Please flag objections here by EOD Thursday.
ops-bot: Pilot deploy scheduled: signed-repair-v0.2 -> staging at 2065432300
Diego (Eng): Ops checklist: 1) verify customer's maintenance window 2) stage rollback image 3) run verification tool 4) apply image and run post-checks (5m health checks). Automatic rollback triggers if error rate >5% within 10m.
Mira (Security): Action: add signed-repair pilot to compliance tracker and prepare attestation templates. Customers wanting no telemetry must sign the "no-remote-support" waiver and accept manual recovery timelines.
Olivia (CS): Draft customer note: "Opting into Signed Repair enables validated, faster fixes. Declining means manual application and longer RTOs. Contact your CSM to enroll or request an exemption."
Cam (VP Product): Thanks all. If nobody objects to the 30-day notice policy, we'll finalize pilot invites tomorrow and start onboarding next week. :white_check_mark:
